information: ### Please note there will only be 2 rounds of 3x3x3 Fewest Moves and no 3x3x3 Cube. Competitors may bring a maximum of 1 guest. [Bali Discovery Speedcubing Masters 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BaliDiscoveryMasters2024) will be held on the weekend following this competition. **Important** In accordance with articles [2g](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2g), [2k](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k), and [2l](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l), competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA Regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate.
